title: kaiak usage record
description: One routed request's settled usage (docs/specs/CONTROL-PROTOCOL.md, Usage records). Never a key, a credential, or request or response content.

request_id.description: The request's X-Request-Id: the client's when valid, else generated by the gateway.

groups.description: The key's group path in the config the request ran under, top-level group first, the key's own group last. The usage counts toward each listed group the control plane's current config defines, and toward global.

model.description: The model name on that backend.

units.description: Usage units; every record carries the four token units, zeros included. Other units join when their models do.

cost_nano_usd.description: Cost in billionths of a US dollar, rounded once per record.

estimated.description: Units estimated: the backend reported no usage.

partial.description: The response stopped early; units count what was relayed.

gateway_time.description: When the gateway settled the record; informational, the control plane aggregates by its own clock.
